check_text:
protocol.py: 4 biology problems (3 warnings, 1 note).

1. WARNING WELL-CAPACITY: More liquid than the well is rated for: 200 ul against 100 ul, 12
wells
   line 37:  p300.dispense(100, plate[well])
   At line 37 the robot filled wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 4 more in slot 4
   past the 100 ul the maker states for it (this line did it 12 times), reaching 200 ul,
   under the 217 ul the well holds to its rim. Above the stated maximum the liquid climbs
   the wall and wets the seal, a tip going in displaces it over the edge, and the volumes
   still add up on paper, so the plate map does not see it and the simulator says nothing.
   Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 4 more in slot 4.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 4 more in slot 4.
   Fix: Use labware rated for the volume, or scale every volume down so the fullest well
   stays under the stated maximum with room to mix.
   Source: Opentrons labware schema 2: totalLiquidVolume, the total well volume in
   microlitres
           https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Opentrons/opentrons/edge/shared-data/labware/schemas/2.json
   Source: Bartley et al. 2023, LabOP: a protocol never adds more liquid than its container
   holds
           https://jakebeal.github.io/Publications/JETC23-LabOP.pdf
   [098d11a78d2f]

2. WARNING WELL-CAPACITY: Mixing in a nearly full well: 200 of 217 ul, 12 wells
   line 42:  p300.dispense(150, plate[well])
   At line 42 the tip mixes wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 4 more in slot 4
   holding 200 ul of the 217.336 ul the well can take (this line did it 12 times). A mixing
   stroke pushes air and the tip's own volume into the well, and a well over nine tenths
   full spills. Wells: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 4 more in slot 4.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 4 more in slot 4.
   Fix: Mix with a smaller stroke, or leave more room in the well.
   Source: Opentrons labware schema 2: totalLiquidVolume, the total well volume in
   microlitres
           https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Opentrons/opentrons/edge/shared-data/labware/schemas/2.json
   Source: Bartley et al. 2023, LabOP: a protocol never adds more liquid than its container
   holds
           https://jakebeal.github.io/Publications/JETC23-LabOP.pdf
   [ef88d573ef04]

3. WARNING MIX-BEFORE-DRAW: Liquid drawn from well A1 in slot 3 before it was mixed: added
at line 46, drawn at line 28 and line 52
   line 46:  p300.dispense(100, reservoir["A1"])
   At line 46 liquid was added to well A1 in slot 3, which already held a different liquid
   (this line did it 6 times). At line 28 and line 52 liquid was drawn out of it again, and
   the well was never mixed in between. Two liquids layered in a small well do not mix on
   their own, so what the tip drew is not at the concentration you calculated. In a dilution
   series every later step inherits the error.
   Affected: well A1 in slot 3.
   Also reached 12 other wells: wells A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9 and 4 more in slot 4.
   Fix: Mix the well after the addition at line 46: `mix_after=(5, volume)` in a transfer,
   or `pipette.mix(5, volume, well)`. Integra suggests about 5 cycles at about 80% of the
   volume in the well.
   Source: Integra: how to perform serial dilutions
           https://www.integra-biosciences.com/global/en/applicationguide/master-art-pipetting-and-learn-how-perform-serial-dilutions-our-comprehensive-guide
   Source: Svec et al. 2015: how good is a PCR efficiency estimate
           https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4822216/
   [b9995a320a0f]

4. NOTE CONTAM-STOCK: A used tip went into a stock: drug (tube A1 in slot 2)
   line 36:  p300.aspirate(100, src)
   At line 36 the tip went into drug (tube A1 in slot 2) while it still carried pbs (well A1
   in slot 3) from an earlier step. A tip that has touched one liquid leaves a little of it
   in the next liquid it touches, so this stock now holds material that does not belong
   there. The protocol does not draw from it again, so this run is not harmed, but what is
   left in the stock is no longer clean for the next run.
   Affected: tube A1 in slot 2.
   Fix: Pick up a fresh tip before line 36 goes into the stock. Or change the order: hand
   out the shared liquid first, while the tip is still clean, and add the other liquids
   afterwards with a fresh tip each.
   Source: Lab Manager: minimizing cross-contamination in automated liquid handling
           https://www.labmanager.com/minimizing-cross-contamination-in-automated-liquid-handling-workflows-35194
   Source: WHO: dos and don'ts for molecular testing
           https://www.who.int/teams/global-malaria-programme/case-management/diagnosis/nucleic-acid-amplification-based-diagnostics/dos-and-don-ts-for-molecular-testing
   [4109882a8a3a]

The Opentrons simulator (8.8.2) passed this protocol with no error: it checks that the robot
can make the moves, not what they do to the liquids.
